item.title: Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source Customer-Session Identity-Switch Account Takeover (CVE-2026-71362)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — web · CVE-2026-71362 / Adobe APSB26-92. Status: Weaponized. Affects: Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B and Magento Open Source — Magento\Customer\Controller\Account\Edit and Magento\Customer\Model\Session. Tags: Magento, Adobe Commerce, account takeover, mass assignment, CWE-863, session, pre-auth, PHP, e-commerce.
